   - For \( n = 10 \), \( P(10) = 1 \) because she is already at the target.
   - For \( n > 10 \), \( P(n) = 0 \) because she cannot reach 10 from a position higher than 10.
   - For \( n < 10 \), the probability \( P(n) \) is the sum of probabilities of jumping from \( n \) to \( n + k \) for all positive integers \( k \):

     \[
     P(n) = \sum_{m=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{2^m} P(n + m)
     \]
